enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: True to confirm write access by test-pushing to the repository, false to give it up.

ssh_url.title: Ssh Url
ssh_url.description: SSH URL, or folder path, of the catalog's repository. Required when it was subscribed to over https, which cannot be pushed to.

ssh_key_path.title: Ssh Key Path
ssh_key_path.description: Private key to authenticate with. Empty string clears it back to the admin user's key; omitted leaves it unchanged.
